status: baseline-calibrated, frozen before candidate performance execution

definitions.scope: All complete non-warmup long-P-ingress windows of every prescribed primary and separately named native-reference run; no window or stream selection by result.
definitions.streams: All four stage=seed requests, each with all512 observed actor-delivered token arrivals.
definitions.full_window_max_gap_ms: max(arrival_ns[i+1]-arrival_ns[i])/1e6 for every individual seed stream, i=0..510.
definitions.ingress_interval: actual long-P request admit_ns through its first arrival_ns; verify four seed counts=32 at admission.
definitions.ingress_intersecting_gaps: Consecutive seed arrival intervals [a,b] with b>longP.admit_ns and a<longP.first_arrival_ns. Retain each intersecting gap and report its maximum.
definitions.count_gt_100ms: Count all individual seed gaps strictly greater than100000000ns; threshold reused from historical MuxPD every-token-gap SLO, not fitted to candidate output.
definitions.reporting: Preserve all individual gaps/stream summaries and each process/window; descriptive ratios only. No primary metric replacement, acceptance gate, selected retries, pooled-token significance test, or HTTP/sustainable-capacity Goodput claim.

motivation: A single ingress affects about1/511 gaps per seed; P99 alone can omit its largest observed interruption. Native-sync control1 is already observed, so this is explicitly supplementary/calibration-informed rather than an untouched primary endpoint.
